name: restoke
description: Restoke hospitality back-of-house analytics via the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. List venue IDs for HQ-level accounts and pull row-level Reports API data (covers, sales, labor, waste, and more) for a date range. Single account-level restaurant/HQ key, no OAuth.

connection.instructions: Generate a restaurant/HQ API key in Restoke (a UUID). This is a single account-level key — for an HQ account it covers every venue under it — not a per-user credential. Provide it to mySMB ops to register as the RESTOKE_CLIENT_SECRET_STAGING / production secret on myhub-mcp-servers.
